deficits.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing on the right side to improve safety for pedestrians crossing at this busy intersection.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing at this busy intersection.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to improve accessibility for pedestrians with mobility aids and wheelchairs.
Enhance street lighting at the crossing to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: The right side of the intersection is obscured by the building overhang and vehicles.
The full width and layout of the intersection are not visible to determine if a refuge is missing.
The kerb edges at the crossing points are not clearly visible in the frames.
Lighting levels are insufficient to judge deficits, and the measure 'improve_crossing' does not address lighting.
